user.description:
A password can't be used here — Origin's login form is behind Kasada bot protection that blocks automated sign-ins.

1. Sign in at originenergy.com.au in your browser (with DevTools closed).
2. In the same tab, go to {jwks_url} — this loads a page on the auth domain so the cookies become visible.
3. Open DevTools → Application → Cookies → {cookie_origin}.
4. Copy both the `auth0` and `did` cookie values and paste them below as:
`auth0=s%3A...; did=s%3A...`

reauth_confirm.description: Your Origin Energy session has expired. Sign in again at originenergy.com.au and paste your `auth0` and `did` cookies (`auth0=...; did=...`) for id.originenergy.com.au. Your existing energy history will be kept.

error.invalid_auth: That session cookie was rejected. Make sure you copied both `auth0` and `did` cookies for id.originenergy.com.au while signed in.
error.mfa_required: Auth0 requires your device identifier (`did`) cookie alongside `auth0` to skip MFA. Please paste both as: `auth0=s%3A...; did=s%3A...`.
error.no_services: No electricity service found on this account
error.blocked: Origin's bot protection refused the request before it reached the login server. Your session cookie is probably fine. Try again in a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: This Origin Energy account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in is for a different Origin Energy account. Use the account this entry was set up with, or add a second entry for the other one.

init.description: Origin publishes each day's usage in a single overnight batch, and the exact publication hour varies. Polling every few hours picks up new batches promptly.
